selectionMethod: CPU raw/repaired/3x3 contacts plus structure, seam, directional and normal-stability diagnostics; candidate use still needs Blender light/world-scale review

materials.reason: Useful warm oxide/green coating shift without losing mottled structure; luminance correlation .969 and gradient correlation .816. Select first result; tile-size-four comparison was byte-identical.
Restrained green coating haze preserves etched-line feature correlation .922; useful coated instrument/glass accent distinct from base gray etch. Not a physical iridescence claim.

Horizontal dry-to-weathered morph retains band direction and .839 gradient correlation with .0065 linear RGB change; useful damp transition. Vertical/strong variants erase or multiply the meaningful waterline.
Warmer green micro-coating variant retains .978 luminance and .902 gradient correlation; no saturated pixels. Apply locally in botanical/shore growth, not as blanket replacement.

retainedBaselineRoles.terracotta: Existing scalar baseline keeps authored mortar and readable contrast; Tessa is best image round-trip fidelity (.986 feature correlation) but near-identity change is not sufficient reason for an extra shipped variant.
retainedBaselineRoles.prismatic-etch: Base stays the clear etch; the haze is an optional coating variant. Nonlocal image blur loses too much line detail (.212 feature correlation).
retainedBaselineRoles.moss-lichen: Base stays the main botanical finish; Tessa's low-amplitude round-trip is useful evidence but not automatically an aesthetic improvement.

rejections.copper-patina-tessa-noisy: The calibrated simulator reduced 64x64 input to 21x21 output. After documented diagnostic resampling, only .027 source-gradient correlation remains; retain as a capacity/noise finding, not improved patina.
rejections.copper-patina-kernel-mid-global: Stronger .30 kernel visibly flips the coating/lightness relationship (luminance correlation -.677). Keep restrained .10 for readable oxide instead.
rejections.terracotta-image-ry: Introduces directional grid artifacts; .652 feature correlation, compared with .924 for image rx and .986 for Tessa palette.
rejections.terracotta-tele-vertical: Smears legible mortar into vertical banding; .159 luminance correlation.
rejections.quay-waterline-tele-vertical: Exaggerated horizontal stripe stack and .349 feature correlation.
rejections.quay-waterline-tele-strong: Loses the useful original waterline (.398 feature correlation).
rejections.copper-patina-tele-global: Visual corrosion detail becomes redistributed speckle with negative source-feature correlation; do not infer better weathering from larger change.
rejections.copper-patina-kernel-four: Byte-identical to kernel-global despite tile_size difference; preserve evidence, do not ship a fake new variant.
